newsitem.title: POLAND: SAB given deadline for Polish brewery bid.
newsitem.headline: SAB given deadline for Polish brewery bid.

text.p: Poland expects the final bid for its second largest brewer Browary Tyskie from a consortium of Polish Euro Agro Centrum SA and South African Breweries (SAB) by September 27, the privatisation minister said on Thursday.
Wieslaw Kaczmarek told a news conference on Thursday that if he did not receive a final offer from the group, he would consider cancelling the tender for the state-owned Tychy.
"I asked that the consortium make the final decision on its Tychy bid by the end of the week. If not... I will have to decide on Monday whether to cancel the tender...," he said.
He added that in such a case the ministry could reconsider previous offers, rejected earlier this year.

According to newspaper reports other bidders were: Australia's Fosters, a consortium of Polish Bank Pekao SA and Oesterreichische Brau Beteiligungs AG and a consortium of Heineken NV, Stalexport and Bank Rozwoju Eksportu (BRE) bank.
Tychy brewery, in which the ministry is offering up to 75 percent of shares, produced 1.6 million hectolitres of beer last year and had a net profit of 23.6 million zlotys.
